title: Berekar Berekon in the production dialog
description: The Winnu agent (exhaust to reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 2) is now offered inside its owner's own production dialog, before the first purchase: a toggle that lowers the displayed total by 2 and is sent first when the builds are confirmed. Before, it was only a separate reaction question ahead of the dialog, and never appeared for Warfare, Construction or Minister of Industry production. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server (rules version 26); the engine side is covered by its own tests.

shots.heading: Toggle off, carrier staged
shots.caption: The new row 'Exhaust Berekar Berekon: -2 cost' sits above the builds. With a carrier staged the total is 3.

shots.heading: Toggle on
shots.caption: The total drops to 1 and the bill shows a cost reduction of -2. Confirm sends the exhaust first, then the carrier; the card exhausts and the carrier is priced at 1.

shots.heading: Nothing in reach without the card
shots.caption: When no build is affordable but the 2 would bring one within reach, the card is a button of its own; taking it exhausts the card and the dialog asks again with the builds at the new prices.

notes.title: Only before the first purchase
notes.text: The card reduces the combined cost of the produced units, so it is offered until the first unit is bought in a use of PRODUCTION, and not at all for production by an ability.

notes.title: Other players' production
notes.text: The reaction window stays for another player's production, where the owner cannot see a dialog of their own.
